name.quote: there is created within the department the Construction Industry Licensing Board

type.quote: The board shall consist of 18 members, of whom: Four are primarily engaged in business as general contractors; Three are primarily engaged in business as building contractors or residential contractors ... exams.name: Contractor certification examination (air-conditioning / mechanical)
exams.notes: Applicant with baccalaureate in building construction with GPA 3.0+ need only take the business and finance portion. Oral examination available to those with 10 years experience who lack reading comprehension.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Florida Construction Industry Licensing Board / Department of Business and Professional Regulation)
exams.quote: Any person who desires to engage in contracting on a statewide basis shall, as a prerequisite thereto, establish his or her competency and qualifications to be certified pursuant to this part. To establish competency, a person shall pass the appropriate examination approved by the board and certified by the department.

interval_years.quote: Each certificateholder or registrant who desires to continue as a certificateholder or registrant shall renew the certificate or registration every 2 years.

required.quote: Each certificateholder or registrant shall provide proof, in a form established by rule of the board, that the certificateholder or registrant has completed at least 14 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium since the issuance or renewal of the certificate or registration.

hours_per_period.quote: completed at least 14 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium

period_years.quote: completed at least 14 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium

value: Florida Building Code advanced/specialized module courses
topical_requirements.quote: The board shall establish by rule that a portion of the required 14 hours must deal with the subject of workers' compensation, business practices, workplace safety, and, for applicable licensure categories, wind mitigation methodologies, and 1 hour of which must deal with laws and rules.

available.quote: The board shall certify as qualified for certification by endorsement any applicant who: Meets the requirements for certification as set forth in this section; has passed a national, regional, state, or United States territorial licensing examination that is substantially equivalent to the examination required by this part

requirements.value: Endorsement available if applicant (1) passed a substantially equivalent exam and meets FL requirements; (2) holds a valid license from another state/territory with substantially equivalent criteria; (3) state has entered a reciprocal agreement with the board; or (4) has held a valid license in another state/territory for at least 10 years. Division I contractors must complete a 2-hour Florida Building Code course.
requirements.quote: Holds a valid license to practice contracting issued by another state or territory of the United States, if the criteria for issuance of such license were substantially equivalent to Florida's current certification criteria

exists.quote: there is created within the department the Construction Industry Licensing Board ... One is primarily engaged in business as an air-conditioning contractor; One is primarily engaged in business as a mechanical contractor

title_protection.quote: No person shall: Falsely hold himself or herself or a business organization out as a licensee, certificateholder, or registrant

scope_protection.quote: No person may engage in the business of contracting in this state without first being certified or registered in the proper classification.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a certificate or registration by fraud or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a certificate or registration by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of a crime directly related to the practice of contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of contracting or the ability to practice contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any act which assists a person or entity in engaging in prohibited uncertified and unregistered contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any act which assists a person or entity in engaging in the prohibited uncertified and unregistered practice of contracting, if the certificateholder or registrant knows or has reasonable grounds to know that the person or entity was uncertified and unregistered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly combining or conspiring with an uncertified or unregistered person by allowing one's certificate or registration to be used to evade the law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly combining or conspiring with an uncertified or unregistered person by allowing his or her certificate or registration to be used by the uncertified or unregistered person with intent to evade the provisions of this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting as a contractor in a name other than that on the certificate or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any certificate or registration issued hereunder except in the name of the certificateholder or registrant as set forth on the issued certificate or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing mismanagement or misconduct in the practice of contracting that causes financial harm to a customer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing mismanagement or misconduct in the practice of contracting that causes financial harm to a customer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by any municipality or county for an act or violation of this part.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being disciplined by any municipality or county for an act or violation of this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this part or violating a rule or lawful order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this part or violating a rule or lawful order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a construction project in which the contractor is engaged or under contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning a construction project in which the contractor is engaged or under contract as a contractor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a statement with respect to a project falsely indicating bonding, payment, or insurance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing a statement with respect to a project or contract falsely indicating that the work is bonded; falsely indicating that payment has been made for all subcontracted work, labor, and materials which results in a financial loss to the owner, purchaser, or contractor; or falsely indicating that workers' compensation and public liability insurance are provided.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud or deceit in the practice of contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing fraud or deceit in the practice of contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing incompetency or misconduct in the practice of contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing incompetency or misconduct in the practice of contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross negligence, repeated negligence, or negligence resulting in significant danger to life or property.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing gross negligence, repeated negligence, or negligence resulting in a significant danger to life or property.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building department permits and inspections.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building department permits and inspections.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intimidating, threatening, coercing, or otherwise discouraging service of a notice to owner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intimidating, threatening, coercing, or otherwise discouraging the service of a notice to owner under part I of chapter 713 or a notice to contractor under chapter 255 or part I of chapter 713.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to satisfy within a reasonable time the terms of a civil judgment related to the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to satisfy within a reasonable time, the terms of a civil judgment obtained against the licensee, or the business organization qualified by the licensee, relating to the practice of the licensee's profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing misapplication of construction funds in violation of s. 713.345.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing misapplication of construction funds in violation of s. 713.345.

bonding_required.quote: The board shall, by rule, adopt guidelines for determination of financial stability, which may include minimum requirements for net worth, cash, and bonding for Division I certificateholders of no more than $20,000 and for Division II certificateholders of no more than $10,000.

insurance_required.quote: the applicant shall submit an affidavit on a form provided by the board attesting to the fact that the applicant has obtained workers' compensation insurance as required by chapter 440, public liability insurance, and property damage insurance for the safety and welfare of the public, in amounts determined by rule of the board.

definition_quote.value: "Class A air-conditioning contractor" means a contractor whose services are unlimited in the execution of contracts requiring the experience, knowledge, and skill to install, maintain, repair, fabricate, alter, extend, or design, if not prohibited by law, central air-conditioning, refrigeration, heating, and ventilating systems, including duct work in connection with a complete system if such duct work is performed by the contractor as necessary to complete an air-distribution system, boiler and unfired pressure vessel systems, and all appurtenances, apparatus, or equipment used in connection therewith, and any duct cleaning and equipment sanitizing that requires at least a partial disassembling of the system

qualifier_required.quote: A qualifying agent must be certified or registered under this part in order for the business organization to operate in the category of contracting in which the qualifying agent is certified or registered.

qualifier_license_type_required.quote: A qualifying agent must be certified or registered under this part in order for the business organization to operate in the category of contracting in which the qualifying agent is certified or registered.

qualifier_cessation_notification_days.quote: if the qualifying agent is the only certified or registered contractor affiliated with the business organization, the business organization shall notify the department of the termination of the qualifying agent and shall have 60 days from the termination of the qualifying agent's affiliation with the business organization in which to employ another qualifying agent.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: the business organization shall notify the department of the termination of the qualifying agent and shall have 60 days from the termination of the qualifying agent's affiliation with the business organization in which to employ another qualifying agent.

natural_gas_facilities_installation_auth.quote: The scope of work for such contractor also includes any excavation work incidental thereto, but does not include any work such as liquefied petroleum or natural gas fuel lines within buildings, except for disconnecting or reconnecting changeouts of liquefied petroleum or natural gas appliances within buildings

value: credit report from nationally recognized credit agency
14-hour financial responsibility course (covers 50% of financial requirements)
financial_responsibility_demonstration_m.quote: the applicant shall furnish a credit report from a nationally recognized credit agency that reflects the financial responsibility of the applicant and evidence of financial responsibility, credit, and business reputation of either himself or herself or the business organization he or she desires to qualify. The board shall adopt rules defining financial responsibility based upon the applicant's credit history, ability to be bonded, and any history of bankruptcy or assignment of receivers. The board may also adopt rules that would allow applicants to demonstrate financial responsibility, as an alternative to the foregoing, by providing minimum credit scores or bonds payable as prescribed for financially responsible officers.

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: any person, business organization, or qualifying agent engaged in the business of contracting in this state and certified or registered under this part shall, as a condition precedent to the issuance or renewal of a certificate or registration of the contractor, provide to the Construction Industry Licensing Board, as provided by board rule, evidence of workers' compensation coverage pursuant to chapter 440.

public_liability_insurance_required.quote: the applicant shall submit an affidavit on a form provided by the board attesting to the fact that the applicant has obtained workers' compensation insurance as required by chapter 440, public liability insurance, and property damage insurance for the safety and welfare of the public, in amounts determined by rule of the board.

small_project_exemption_threshold_dollar.quote: Any work or operation of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature in which the aggregate contract price for labor, materials, and all other items is less than $2,500

license_number_on_permits_required.quote: Each registered or certified contractor shall affix the number of his or her registration or certification to each application for a building permit and on each building permit issued and recorded.

scope_expansion_by_rule_authorized.quote: The addition of a new type of contractor or the expansion of the scope of practice of any type of contractor under this part shall not limit the scope of practice of any existing type of contractor under this part unless the Legislature expressly provides such a limitation.
